build_pwclite_flow_estimator: build a PWCLite model for optical flow estimation with configurable feature extractor and correlation layers
create_feature_extractor_pyramid: create a feature pyramid extractor that processes images through convolutional layers and optionally injects adjacency map features
run_flow_estimator_dense: run a dense flow estimator that uses multi-scale residual convolutions to predict optical flow from concatenated feature maps
test_context_network_flow: test a context network with dilated convolutions that refines coarse flow predictions into fine-grained optical flow outputs
review_upflow_network_upsample: review an upflow network that upsamples coarse flow fields using learned convex combination masks
